BiblicalUsage: Batsiyr is the grape harvest, the vintage, the gathering of the grapes. The law promises the threshing will reach to the vintage and the vintage to the sowing time, Gideon says the gleaning of Ephraim is better than the vintage of Abiezer, Isaiah says the earth will be like the shaking of an olive tree and the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done, and Micah says he is like the gleanings of the summer fruits when there is no cluster to eat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vintage is the Bible's picture of a harvest that is both gift and judgment, because the same gathering that feeds a people in obedience leaves nothing when the land is judged. Gideon's gleaning honours Ephraim, and I hold that God counts the gleanings as carefully as He counts the harvest.
